verdict: Meta ads are delivering efficiently; program buildout remains significantly behind schedule.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 89 leads from Meta at a cost of $12.59 per lead, and efficiency is trending in the right direction — spend fell 22.6% week over week while leads dropped only 4%, pushing the cost per lead down roughly 19%. Google Ads and Search campaigns are not yet live, so Meta is carrying the full load. Your Google Business Profile generated 113 actions this period, including 82 direction requests and 7 calls, though profile activity softened in the most recent week and is being monitored. Ten program milestones spanning CRM setup, landing pages, search campaigns, and nurture sequences remain incomplete against due dates that ran from July 31 through September 30; closing that gap is the priority for the period ahead.
